main_body: deciduous tree with leafy canopy and vertical brown trunk
top_band: upper lit canopy crown (rows 1-14, lighter green foliage clumps)
evidence: Volumetric rounded tree canopy (rows 1-30) with upper lit foliage clusters (rows 1-14) overhanging lower shaded clumps (rows 15-30) and casting a shadow onto the top of the vertical brown trunk (rows 30-45).

style.evidence: The candidate is enclosed in a solid 1px pure/near-black outline around both the canopy and the straight pipe-like trunk, giving it a strong sticker look compared to the reference trees which use dark green/brown material tones and open leaf silhouettes. The trunk is a simple straight column with two flat brown vertical bands and a flat horizontal black bottom line, lacking the organic roots, branches, and detailed leaf clusters of the Beodeul references.
